post_pass.rule: each region substituted toward ITS OWN palette ([top] + top_extras, nearest anchor), background integer-exact per region, then rim suppression. Flat surfaces take the ordered ground; the cliff face takes the ground actually DETECTED on it.
post_pass.cliff_detection: HUE first: a cliff is only foreign when its hue departs from the tile's own flat surface (shadow keeps hue), then named 1-of-15 by the mix meter; the winner must beat the ordered ground by 0.6 nats/px and the face must exceed 60px, so a cliff that is merely the ordered ground in shadow keeps its own palette
post_pass.dir: <dir>/post/<name from post_files> - read the name, never build it
post_pass.cliff_ground: index-aligned with post_files: the ground each tile's cliff was painted toward
